question: Can a learner ground a tiny unfamiliar utterance system in observed objects and action consequences, directly write numerical association weights, compose unseen instructions and preserve knowledge, at the same experience budget as a fitted trained control?
hypothesis: A fixed gated numeric acoustic-address memory can acquire primitive noun, destination and verb associations from 10 actual demonstrations and compose held-out instructions without iterative optimization of those associations. The supplied three-slot syntax, acoustic symbol boundaries, two candidate verb mechanisms, and action simulator are not discovered. A matched evidence-table control should tie; neural superiority is not presumed.

inputs.name: synthetic grounded microlanguage
inputs.source: stdlib-only SHA256-derived deterministic synthetic utterance forms; public, no real-language data, no private inputs
inputs.sha256: Defined by frozen generator formula: SHA256('WSP51|'+cohort+'|'+seed+'|'+encoding+'|'+role+'|'+index), first 8-bit unique unused address by counter increments; actual input records and digests emitted by evaluator before scoring; no held-out answer revealed to learner.

world: Four visible distinguishable entities with one binary position each, observed through explicit pointing; two destination effects (0/1). Two candidate verb rules place(target) and avoid(target), names permuted per world. Acoustic forms are random unique byte-valued pulse addresses, not existing vocabulary. A three-frame utterance with supplied pause boundaries has fixed [verb,noun,destination] syntax. Learner never gets the world's private acoustic maps or a demonstration of a full three-frame composition outside verb evidence. Verbs are inferred from actual before/after world transitions, with both candidate hypotheses checked. Target demos identify destination by actual environment sensor, nouns by actual pointing. All observations and actions counted.
exposure: Exactly 4 noun pointing experiences + 2 destination pointing experiences + 4 verb action demonstrations (2 per verb, at both targets with reset/reference physical states explicitly charged). All arms receive identical ordered observations. No label hints except observed event consequences and predefined verb-hypothesis family. Acoustic identity is reencoded by one-to-one unique 8-bit pulse map per condition, not provided to learner. All learners begin empty and have no pretrained language.

models.direct: Three numeric bitplane memories (noun 256x2, destination 256x1, verb 256x1) and occupancy masks; acoustic equality gates write concept values learned from observed grounding, with contradictory observations setting a per-address conflict bit and preventing confident prediction; decoder composes via fixed supplied syntax and action arithmetic.
models.trained: Independent one-hot linear logistic/softmax learner: same three acoustic input/output heads, trained on the identical 10 event labels with frozen 100 full-order SGD passes, step size 0.2, no pretrained embeddings and no additional observations; use fixed winner with calibrated abstention on unobserved pulse forms. Training and inference CPU/time count.
models.evidence_table: Strong exact symbolic paired-experience dictionary with same source observations, fixed syntax, action and abstention; expected to tie direct writes.
models.erase: Same decoding/effector structure with no acquired association weights; reports only unknown.

frozen_design.split: DEV only 103; PRIMARY 2309,2311,2333,2357. No cross-cohort seed reuse. Three encoding conditions per seed.
frozen_design.ordering: Ground nouns in source entity order0..3, then destinations0..1, then verbs by source order, each with both destination observations. Heldout 16 [verb2 x noun4 x destination2] compositions in lexicographic semantic order; learner sees acoustic frames only. Evaluator labels withheld until scoring.
frozen_design.data_budget: 10 teacher experiences per encoding condition; no data augmentation or free reruns; 16 heldout compositions (not supplied during learning); 4 unknown-pulse negatives; 1 contradiction per condition after primary readout; single cold reload; 4 swapped-slot negatives.
frozen_design.compute_budget: Stdlib Python 3.12, 100 passes x10 supervised examples in gradient control; direct/lookup exactly 10 write events; count steps and wall-clock per learner; per-condition <=10000 source-free decoding operations; <=20 seconds local per seed; exact source/actions/timing recorded.
frozen_design.capacity: Direct 3 x 256 addressed word arrays with 2/1/1 output bits, three occupancy masks and conflict mask; trained 256x4 logits + seen masks, table up to10 keys. Capacities not equal; report them explicitly. Fixed grammar/action vocabulary and sampler shared.
frozen_design.evaluator: Execute decoded command from identical fresh known 4-bit entity-state snapshot and compare predicted resulting state to heldout authoritative simulated consequence; count abstentions wrong. Cold restore byte-identity and prediction parity. Unknown and slot-order errors must abstain; retention/contradiction separately.

controls: Minimal-training calibrated linear heads (100 SGD passes, identical experiences)
Novel unpaired acoustic remapping (no transfer claim)

classification_rules.engineering_pass: Focused tests, inherited WSP01-47 full regression, source/identity and actual-observation parity, successful Linux+Windows CI and G29 source atlas on candidate SHA; no source-drift or dirty checkout.
classification_rules.dev_supported: On PRIMARY direct >=95% heldout composition and 100% observed facts, 100% cold parity, zero unknown/slot-order false-confidence, contradiction detected in all 12 conditions; equal source budgets. Gradient and exact-table comparator results all reported, not filtered. No general-language claim.
classification_rules.scientific_supported: Only if direct beats strongest fully trained AND exact-table control by >=5 percentage points on matched PRIMARY composition while passing all dev_supported rules and total cost <= both; no retroactive metric changes. Exact-table expected to tie, so scientific superiority is unlikely in this toy.
classification_rules.mixed: Any informative incomplete result or bounded gain without all thresholds, including control tie, engineering passes without scientific superiority.
classification_rules.negative: Direct fails preregistered dev thresholds with complete valid evidence; or direct provides no advantage over strongest controls (explicitly record tie as no superiority).
classification_rules.invalid: Source or seed leakage, nonshared evidence, heldout labels supplied to learner, unmatched action budget, corrupted restore accepted, missing controls, unstable source identity or failed qualification prevents scientific result.

risks: Fixed word/pause segmentation and 3-slot syntax are supplied, not learned. This is artificial compositional grounding, not natural-language understanding.
The teacher explicitly points and exposes actions; knowledge cannot be inferred without source information.
Two verb hypotheses are preprogrammed, not invented. Novel grammar/real audio/general cognition remain untested.
Address memory is a full 256-slot lookup; direct weight writing could tie an ordinary table. Count capacity and no blanket training-cost advantage claim.
Standard trained one-hot head uses supervised labels inferred from sensory consequences; this is a limited conventional baseline, not strongest modern neural model.
preregistration_note: This frozen prereg commit precedes any WSP51 implementation, DEV or PRIMARY. Any corrections post implementation must be non-outcome-informed and versioned explicitly before protected PRIMARY; no scientific claim without original-source qualification.
